WITH RECURSIVE menu_tree AS (
SELECT m.menu_no AS menuNo , m.menu_name AS menuName , m.parent_no AS parentNo , m.menu_lev AS menuLev , m.sort_ord AS sortOrd , m.pro_no AS proNo , CAST(LPAD(m.sort_ord, 5, '0') AS CHAR(200)) AS path FROM menu m
JOIN menu_role_perm mrp ON m.menu_no = mrp.menu_no AND mrp.role_no = #{roleNo} AND mrp.disp_perm = 'Y'
WHERE (m.parent_no IS NULL OR m.parent_no = 0) AND m.use_yn = 'Y'
UNION ALL
SELECT m.menu_no , m.menu_name , m.parent_no , m.menu_lev , m.sort_ord , m.pro_no , CONCAT(mt.path, '/', LPAD(m.sort_ord, 5, '0')) FROM menu m JOIN menu_tree mt ON m.parent_no = mt.menuNo
JOIN menu_role_perm mrp ON m.menu_no = mrp.menu_no AND mrp.role_no = #{roleNo} AND mrp.disp_perm = 'Y'
WHERE m.use_yn = 'Y'
)
SELECT mt.menuNo AS menuNo , mt.menuName AS menuName , mt.parentNo AS parentNo , mt.menuLev AS menuLev , mt.sortOrd AS sortOrd , TRIM(LEADING '/' FROM p.pro_path) AS proPath FROM menu_tree mt LEFT JOIN program p ON mt.proNo = p.pro_no AND p.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY mt.path
